# طلب المساعدة من عمو كامل

01:13.00 آه
01:14.00 عمو كامل! عمو كامل! عمو كامل!

# وصول عمو كامل

01:20.00 ممكن تيجي تساعدنا؟

01:24.00 تعال ساعدنا الحنفية بتنقط
01:26.00 حاضر أنا جاي

# عواقب تسرب المياه
01:31.00 بتعرف يا جلجل؟

01:59.00 عمو كامل!

# إصلاح الحنفية
02:05.00 هي وصل عمو كامل

phrases.text_l2: Jaljal
Hmm?
Jaljal, can you hear?
I hear, I hear
Do you hear a sound?
I definitely hear a sound

phrases.text_l1: لا جلجل في صوت إشي بنقط
phrases.text_l2: No Jaljal, it's the sound of something dripping

phrases.text_l1: آه آه مزبوط في إشي بنقط
phrases.text_l2: Ah ah, right, something is dripping

phrases.text_l1: جلجل بقولك في صوت إشي بنقط
phrases.text_l2: Jaljal, I'm telling you, there's a sound of something dripping

phrases.text_l1: همم أكيد في إشي بنقط يا تن تن
phrases.text_l2: Hmm, surely something is dripping, Ten Ten
There it is, surely the faucet
The faucet, right
No Jaljal, we need to fix it
Huh? Fix it?
Umm, okay, let's go
Come on, let's get up and fix it quickly, come on

phrases.text_l1: شايف يا جلجل قلتلك إنه الحنفية بتنقط
phrases.text_l2: See Jaljal? I told you the faucet is dripping

phrases.text_l1: مزبوط عنجد إنت كتير كتير كتير نبيهة يا تن تن
phrases.text_l2: Right, really, you are very very very smart, Ten Ten
Okay Jaljal, we need to fix it quickly

phrases.text_l1: أكيد لازم نصلحها بس إحنا بدنا حدا يساعدنا
phrases.text_l2: Sure we need to fix it, but we need someone to help us
What do you say we call Uncle Kamel?
Yeah

phrases.text_l1: عمو كامل! عمو كامل! عمو كامل!
phrases.text_l2: Uncle Kamel! Uncle Kamel! Uncle Kamel!

phrases.text_l1: إيش يا جلجل؟ إيش يا تن تن؟ إيش في؟
phrases.text_l2: What is it Jaljal? What is it Ten Ten? What's wrong?
Can you come help us?
What's the problem?
Come help us, the faucet is dripping
Okay, I'm coming
You know, Jaljal?
Yes

phrases.text_l1: لو ضلت الحنفية تنقط هيك ما رح نقدر نشرب مي
phrases.text_l2: If the faucet keeps dripping like this, we won't be able to drink water
Right, and we won't be able to take a shower
We won't be able to swim

phrases.text_l1: مزبوط ولا كمان رح نقدر نغسل إيدينا
phrases.text_l2: Right, and also we won't be able to wash our hands
Oh oh oh
You know, Jaljal?
Yes

phrases.text_l1: كمان ما رح أقدر أسقي الشجر ولا أسبح سمكتي
phrases.text_l2: Also I won't be able to water the plants or let my fish swim
Right, many things

phrases.text_l1: ممكن كمان ما أقدر أفرشي سناني آخ
phrases.text_l2: Maybe also I won't be able to brush my teeth, oh
Uncle Kamel!
Uncle Kamel, come quickly
Here comes Uncle Kamel

phrases.text_l1: إذا سمحتي يا تن تن امسكي شوي
phrases.text_l2: If you please, Ten Ten, hold this a bit
Okay
Thanks

phrases.text_l1: هلق بس عمو كامل يصلح الحنفية رح نقدر نشرب مي
phrases.text_l2: Now once Uncle Kamel fixes the faucet, we'll be able to drink water
Sure, and we'll be able to take a shower

phrases.text_l1: رح أقدر أسبح أنا ورح تقدر تسبح سمكتي
phrases.text_l2: I'll be able to swim and your fish will be able to swim
Sure, and we'll be able to water the plants
Ah, the washer is broken and we need to change it

phrases.text_l1: يا سلام شفتوا؟ الحنفية ما بتنقط
phrases.text_l2: Oh wow, did you see? The faucet isn't dripping
Yay!
